name: untapped-index-watch
description: Checks every sitemap URL against Search Console's URL Inspection, says what each problem usually means and what to do, and shows what changed since the last check. Free.

interface.shortDescription: Is every page in Google's index?
interface.longDescription: Signs in to your own Search Console (read-only), inspects each page in your sitemap, and reports indexed / not indexed / unknown with plain-language flags (dropped out, Google picked another canonical, not crawled for weeks, blocked by noindex or robots.txt) and the usual fix. Keeps a local history so you can see pages drop out or get picked up.
defaultPrompt: Are all my pages indexed on Google? My site is example.com
Which pages dropped out of Google's index since last week?
Why isn't my new page showing up on Google?
